faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ISRO NSIL CMD post?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the Chairman-cum-Managing Director (CMD) post at New Space India is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for the CMD post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Chairman-cum-Managing Director (CMD) position is 45 years. There is no maximum age limit specified in the provided details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the CMD position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Chairman-cum-Managing Director (CMD) post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 200000 to Rs. 370000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Chairman-cum-Managing Director (CMD) recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the CMD post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Chairman-cum-Managing Director (CMD) post involves shortlisting by a Search-cum-Selection Committee (SCSC) followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q6. What are the preferred qualifications for the CMD role?
faq.answer: While a graduate degree is required, a graduation in Engineering/Science or an MBA/Two-year Full-time Post Graduate Diploma in Business Administration/Management is preferred for the CMD position.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply offline by downloading the application form, filling it correctly, attaching necessary documents, and sending it via post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Chairman-cum-Managing Director (CMD) position at New Space India is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ISRO NSIL located?
faq.answer: The ISRO NSIL is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with a pincode of 560094.

faq.question: Q10. What kind of experience is required for the CMD post?
faq.answer: Adequate technical, operational, and project management experience at a senior level in a reputed organization is required for the Chairman-cum-Managing Director (CMD) role.
